doc: I31 prereg instrument (the contract is the docstring of tests_m3/test_disch.py). Frozen at the I31 prereg; the build reads it and never edits it. documents: the transitions documents DISCH analyses for M3, the extracted rollup document I20 adopted (spec/M2/lib/derive_extracted.json) and A19 extracted (holon-frontend-solidity/0.3; G1 re-extracts it). Extracted facts are the input of every I31 law (BUILD_PLAN §2.3, docs/HUMAN_ANSWERS.md Q19). model_sidecar: I30's sidecar, whose typed model (gen/M3/sorts/models/<model>.bend: Reach from the binding's deployment, Act, the per-step environment, step_/post_/chk_) every DISCH law is stated over. binding: the I20 binding whose step harness replays every DISCH witness on the real contract. r0: the deployment's abstraction (its own doc). hypotheses: the M2 hypothesis that stands for each external component's behaviour (holon-hypotheses of results/M2/hypotheses.json; its verdict is read from I21's audit/rounds/M2/round2/a4.json), null when none does. search: the refutation budget, I30's (tests_m3/test_sort_types.py, the key I30's thresholds). expected: every class, closure, kind, external component, basis element and law the contract derives from the committed document, computed at the prereg by tests_m3/_i31.py::summary(analysis(document, r0, model)) (inputs pinned by sha256 below); the predicted outcomes are in the key I31 of spec/M3/predictions.json and in tests_m3/test_disch.py's PREDICTED, never here.

r0.doc: The abstraction of the binding's deployment, the initial state R0 of the closure (rules D3-D5 of tests_m3/test_disch.py). It is configuration, not a fact of the code: the I20 binding replay/M2/fragments.json deploys the real Rollup through replay/M1/solidity/HolonTraceReplay.t.sol deploy(tid, F, W, D, t0, r0) with the initial values F = 40, W = 10, D = 20, t0 = 10, r0 = 100 that the binding reads from spec/M1/facts/morph_rollup.json (holonDeploy in replay/M2/solidity/HolonExtractedStep.t.sol): vm.warp(1700000010); Rollup.initialize(submitter oracle, queue proxy, verifier oracle, F, W, 70) behind a TransparentUpgradeableProxy (admin 0xAD); updateRollupDelayPeriod(D); addChallenger(0x1004); importGenesisBatch(g), g the 249-byte version-0 header with dataHash 1, blobVersionedHash ZERO_VERSIONED_HASH and postStateRoot 100. Exact words for the values the closure's checks compare; "T" for a non-zero word the transcription does not fix (owner and contract addresses); every unlisted path is {0}. keys: the mapping keys the deployment wrote, by family, with the members it made non-zero (a struct family), so that tests_m3/test_disch.py::TestInstruments::test_r0_is_the_binding_deployment can compare this transcription slot by slot with I30's capture of the same deployment (gen/M3/sorts/models/morph_rollup.extracted.init.json). The genesis hash is keccak256(g).
